enumeratedWith: top-level keys of integrator-dsp.js's fusion return object, plus every `_exp.<key>` assignment AND every key of the `var _exp = {` slim-export literal — read from SOURCE, because uploads/ is absent in a worktree and in CI. Depth 1 here; one level down is enumerated per subtree under `nested`, and a subtree absent from there is not examined.
seededFrom: a render-mention scan of integrator-render.js on 2026-10-11; the SEED is derived, so the gate's first run proves nothing about today, only about drift from it
corrected: 2026-11-11: the 2026-10-11 seed scan counted a word in a COMMENT or a STRING as a render mention, so `bus` and `staging` were seeded `card` on prose alone — no Integrator surface reads `fusion.bus` or `fusion.staging`. Both now read `export-only`, and the gate asks for a read in blanked code.
widened: 2026-11-12: the enumerator read the `_exp.<key>` assignments and never the `var _exp = {` literal, so ten slim-export keys carried no declaration and the gate passed over 26 of 36. Each of the ten was hand-checked against integrator-render.js under the gate's own blanked-code `reads()`: none of them is read, and `notes` records where the reader meets the same value instead.

notes.kernel: integrator-render.js names a kernel stamp in two comments and reads `r.kernelHash` per node — never this export key.
notes.schema: the method-description block; absent from integrator-render.js in every form.
notes.confirmedApneaIndex: forwards `fusion.apnea.confirmedAHI`, which the reader meets as `a.confirmedAHI` (integrator-render.js:478, :480, :988) through the fusion object and not through this key.
notes.confirmedApneaIndexReportable: forwards `fusion.apnea.confirmedAHIReportable`, which integrator-render.js:478 reads as `a.confirmedAHIReportable` to decide whether the index may be shown.
notes.confirmedApneaIndexContributions: forwards `fusion.apnea.contributions`; no Integrator surface reads either name.
notes.apneaNullModel: forwards `fusion.apnea.nullModel`, which integrator-render.js:477 and :479 read as `a.nullModel` for the below-chance subtitle.
notes.apneaCoupling: forwards `fusion.apnea.coupling`; neither name appears in integrator-render.js.
notes.hrvConsensus: forwards `fusion.hrv`, which is declared `card` and which the reader meets under that name.
notes.deviceScoredAHI: forwards `fusion.apnea.apneaAuthority`, which integrator-render.js reads four times under that name.
notes.handshakes: the reserved-handshake block; integrator-render.js names a handshake once in a sentence (:1085) and reads no key.

apnea.enumeratedWith: the depth-1 keys of EVERY `return {` inside fuseApneaEvents(), unioned — 13 on the no-overlap guard and 14 on the fused path. Read from SOURCE, like the top level.
apnea.readAs: an anchored read: `<alias>.<key>` or `<alias>["<key>"]` inside the scope of a binding of `fusion.apnea`, in blanked code. A bare token cannot tell `fusion.findings` from `a.findings`, because four of these names are ALSO top-level fusion keys.
apnea.seededFrom: the anchored test above, hand-checked against integrator-render.js on 2026-11-12 line by line: every `card` entry below was read at the lines its note names. The anchored test and a bare-token test agree on all 14 keys here, so the anchoring repairs no live miss in this subtree and is a tightening against the next edit.
apnea.nullWhen: integrator-dsp.js builds `fusion.apnea` as `anyOverlap ? fuseApneaEvents(...) : null`, so the whole subtree is absent on a night with no OxyDex x cardiac overlap.

partialShape.consequence: the fused path returns it and the no-overlap guard does not. The guard's comment says a reader never branches on a key's presence, which holds for `contributions` and `overlapCoverage` and not for this one. Nothing reads it, so the branch is latent.

notes.confirmedAHI: the Confirmed apnea index KPI value (integrator-render.js:478, :480) and the finding card headline (:988).
notes.confirmedAHIReportable: integrator-render.js:478 decides with it whether the index may be shown at all.
notes.nullModel: integrator-render.js:477 reads `belowChance`, and :479 reads `expectedConfirmed` for the below-chance subtitle.
notes.apneaAuthority: the Device-scored AHI KPI (integrator-render.js:481, :482) and the finding card (:1012, :1013).
notes.overlapHours: the Confirmed events subtitle, both branches (integrator-render.js:486).
notes.findings: integrator-render.js:486 reads `findings[0].pSpurious`, :487 the count, :988 the count again.
notes.matched: the desat match rate (integrator-render.js:489) and the finding card counts (:995, :999).
notes.unmatched: the finding card names both unmatched pools (integrator-render.js:1004, :1006).
notes.desatObserver: no anchored read; the reader meets the observer through `findings[].nodes` instead.
notes.coupling: no anchored read, and the top-level `apneaCoupling` that forwards it is export-only for the same reason.
notes.contributions: no anchored read, matching the top-level `confirmedApneaIndexContributions` note.
notes.consequence: no anchored read; it is also the one key the two return shapes disagree on.
